subject: Demo for NimblePay — preferred times and corrected invite
body:
From: Aiko Tanaka <aiko.tanaka@nimblepay.jp>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 02:47:00 +0900
Subject: Quick demo — time options (Tokyo/Singapore/Sydney)

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for getting back to us. We’re excited to see Redwood in action — we’re a small payments team in Tokyo and Singapore and want to confirm a short demo (30–40m) focused on routing and cost controls.

Proposed: Tue Apr 5, 10:00 JST (your timezone?)
Alternative: Tue Apr 5, 09:00 SGT / Tue Apr 5, 11:00 AEST

I’ve cc’d Minh (PayAsia SG) who will join from Singapore. Apologies if I mixed timezones — our team works across JP/SG/SYD and sometimes calendar invites flip to the previous day for Sydney folks.

Thanks — Aiko
Attachment: nimble-demo-brief.pdf (pdf stub)

-----
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Aiko Tanaka <aiko.tanaka@nimblepay.jp>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 07:12:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo — time options (Tokyo/Singapore/Sydney)

Hi Aiko — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the times — I want to make sure we don’t introduce any next-day confusion for your Sydney participants. A couple quick notes:

- Timezones: Tokyo (JST) is UTC+9, Singapore (SGT) is UTC+8, Sydney (AEDT) is currently UTC+11 due to DST. That means a 10:00 JST slot is 12:00 AEDT and 09:00 SGT.
- Calendar quirk: some calendar clients show local date/time and can display the event as Apr 4 for Sydney if the invite was created in a different timezone window.

Would any of these slots work for you (I’ll send an updated invite with explicit timezone labels and an .ics):
- Tue Apr 5, 09:00 SGT / 10:00 JST / 12:00 AEDT (30m) — preferred
- Tue Apr 5, 16:00 SGT / 17:00 JST / 19:00 AEDT (shorter overlap for US follow-ups)
- Wed Apr 6, 09:00 SGT / 10:00 JST / 12:00 AEDT (backup)

If you confirm the first option I’ll send a corrected invite that forces explicit timezone display and include a short agenda. Also cc’ing Marissa (solutions) to scope demo content and Sean to help with provisioning a sandbox environment for your routing test.

Best,
Evelyn Hart\Account Executive, Redwood Inference\evelyn.hart@redwood.ai

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 07:45:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo — time options (Tokyo/Singapore/Sydney)

Perfect. If they take the morning slot (09:00 SGT / 10:00 JST / 12:00 AEDT) I’ll prepare:
- Short runbook showing routing policy UI and cost-per-token dashboards
- A 10-min hands-on section to walk through model variant fallback
- 2 example prompts covering high-throughput and low-latency cases

Also: do we need dedicated tokens or any customer-specific config prewarmed?

Marissa

-----
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:03:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo — time options (Tokyo/Singapore/Sydney)

I can spin up a small sandbox on our shared APAC cluster and preload a sample dataset. No special tokens needed for demo — I’ll just provision a temporary key and share before the call. I’ll also capture a screenshot of live latency metrics.

Sean

-----
From: Aiko Tanaka <aiko.tanaka@nimblepay.jp>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Minh Nguyen <minh@payasia.sg>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:22:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo — time options (Tokyo/Singapore/Sydney)

Thanks — the first slot works for us (Tue Apr 5, 09:00 SGT / 10:00 JST / 12:00 AEDT). One small thing: when I accepted the calendar invite earlier it showed Apr 4 for our Sydney participants. Can you please resend with explicit timezone (and an .ics) so Minh and our Sydney office see the correct local day?

Also — attached is a short list of topics we’d like covered (marker in nimble-demo-brief.pdf). Thanks for looping Marissa and Sean.

Aiko

-----
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Aiko Tanaka <aiko.tanaka@nimblepay.jp>, Minh Nguyen <minh@payasia.sg>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:15:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo — time options (Tokyo/Singapore/Sydney) — corrected invite attached

Hi Aiko / Minh — thanks for confirming. I’ve created a corrected invite and attached an .ics that explicitly sets the event timezones for each location to avoid the next-day display in Sydney. Invite details:

Event: Redwood platform demo — routing & cost controls (30m)\When: Tue Apr 5, 09:00 SGT / 10:00 JST / 12:00 AEDT\Where: Zoom (link in invite)
Agenda:
 - 5m intro & goals
 - 15m demo: routing policies + unit economics dashboard
 - 8–10m hands-on walkthrough
 - 5–7m Q&A & next steps

Attachments: corrected-invite.ics (calendar stub), nimble-demo-brief.pdf (from Aiko), screenshots-session-req.png (internal)

Sean will share a temporary sandbox key before the meeting and Marissa will lead the demo. If anything changes on your side, reply to this thread and I’ll update the invite. Looking forward to it.

Best regards,
Evelyn Hart\Account Executive, Redwood Inference\Phone: +1 415-555-0198
